entries.0c161a5ad4fb1882: This is a membership community for growing IT companies. Through events and content for learning hints for growth of businesses and services and the growth cycle model, it supports the growth of its members.
entries.3876fb3cf935556d: This is an area that translates strategies and business ideas into business structures and organizes and forms transformation activities from the perspectives of business processes and digital technology. It provides business consulting, IT consulting, human capital consulting and architecture design.
entries.406528d5ed55c7b0: This is an area that encourages companies' involvement in achieving the SDGs and promotes improvement of the operational capabilities of government organizations and NPOs as well as public-private partnerships. It provides CSR and SDGs promotion, public-private partnerships and regional revitalization, public administration management, and development of social entrepreneurs.
entries.45645173d3110e6b: This is an IT business community that provides a venue for professional crowdsourcing where IT professionals and client companies connect directly. It receives membership fees, matching fees, and fees for participation in events and training.
entries.4da24fef90b40ccf: Operates consulting that supports companies in carrying out transformation, and a platform that connects IT professionals.
entries.5f40cf76358b4cb6: This is a service specializing in matching freelance consultants. Using its network with major business companies and IT and consulting firms, it introduces projects and provides support for administrative work.
entries.7b5986e6d1ebfe61: This business provides a venue where IT professionals and client companies undertaking IT projects connect directly. The company and its consolidated subsidiary LTS Link Co., Ltd. carry out this business, and revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,492 million. As of December 31, 2025, Asain Navi had 14,915 members, corporate and individual combined.
entries.ad18ace35033c8d3: This is an area in which corporate strategy and business strategy are considered together with clients and then formulated and executed. It provides research, M&A support, strategy formulation, business creation and business turnaround, and data analytics.
entries.b613061598ff9d04: Major business companies and IT and consulting firms
entries.bc71960882168c59: Business companies undertaking transformation and DX
entries.d4ae582ee0ed5e33: This consulting business embeds itself in clients' operations and provides, on a one-stop basis, everything from support for establishing business transformation through strategy development and upstream support for IT implementation to visualization and improvement of business processes and execution support. The company and its consolidated subsidiaries Wakuto Co., Ltd., LTS Software Technology Co., Ltd., Hibiya Computer System Co., Ltd., Hibiya Resource Planning Co., Ltd., ME-Lab Japan Co., Ltd., and LTS ASIA Co., Ltd. carry out this business, and revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥15,608 million.
